[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Uwharrie National Forest: 4.5-mile Birkhead Mountain Trail leading to the highest point in the forest.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Lake Norman State Park: 4.2-mile Itusi Trail with views of the lake from several overlooks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] All recommended trails offer scenic views, with some having summit or lake views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Parking at Raven Rock State Park is free, with a large parking lot near the visitor center.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Restrooms are available at the visitor center and picnic area, with primitive restrooms along the Campbell Creek Trail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] No potable water is available along the trail; users should bring enough water and snacks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Park hours are from 7am to 9pm, with the visitor center open from 8am to 5pm.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dogs are allowed on leashes no longer than 6 feet, but some trails may be closed to dogs.
